capabilities.scope: DEBUG UART2 at 115200 8N1 uses exact SPCR correction or gated kernel fallback when SPCR is absent; electrical contact mapping remains unknown.
One-core firmware bootstrap reaches SWITCHED_IN and PONG after bounded allocations. Exposed owners remain held and IRQ masked; no codec frame or independent decode is accepted.

Short-button shutdown reaches native powerd and filesystem unmount in the cited scenario. Restart by short press after shutdown remains unresolved. Hardware wake, removal of power and OS shutdown are separate contracts.

The kernel reads and sets the RX8900 clock through EFI runtime services; no OS I2C or RX8900 driver is used. Time set with date(1) survived one warm reboot. Without a backup battery, it survived one short removal of input power and was lost after a later one; the cause of the difference is unknown. Retention with a battery and drift are unmeasured.
envstat(8) reads 13 ACPI thermal zones at idle. An installed NVMe SSD can also report its composite temperature. Accuracy, cooling control and endurance are unqualified.

sbsawdt0 attaches through the EmberBSD GTDT walk with a 5 s default period, and wdogctl(8) lists it. The OS owner records an armed reset after 5.08 s and 3 minutes with kernel tickles on 26 October 2026; DevBoards has no own record of that check.
Reduced persistent FFS root passes scoped cold/warm default boots and data retention; full base, NVMe and unclean power-loss recovery unqualified.
Two RTL8126 ports pass 5GBASE-T and bounded raw frames including jumbo payloads; IP/TCP, throughput and sustained operation unqualified.
RTL8822CE legacy WPA2/CCMP and scoped scan/reconnect/data recovery; no HT/VHT, calibrated dBm or endurance acceptance.
